notes: Native embedContent passthrough: relayed byte for byte; the server bills it by the request's characters (genaifmt.EmbedInputCharacters). Gemini API embeddings (generativelanguage v1beta discovery, revision 20261028: EmbedContentResponse {embedding, usageMetadata}, BatchEmbedContentsResponse {embeddings, usageMetadata}, ContentEmbedding, EmbeddingUsageMetadata {promptTokenCount, promptTokenDetails}); layout as the recorded embedContent/batchEmbedContents output in google-gemini/cookbook quickstarts/rest/Embeddings_REST.ipynb. gemini-embedding-2 is the current embedding model (cookbook quickstarts/Embeddings.ipynb). Vector values are invented; 128 dimensions because the requests ask for them.
